assessments.zone: Eastern Kongolo territory, Mbulula health zone toward Nyunzu and Kabambare (Brazza/Mbulula, Kayanza, Mweka, Nkulula, Kahenga, Mulala, Nonge, Yenga, Makutano, Kasawa, Mwana Ngoy, Mpala areas)
assessments.evidence: The eastern Kongolo borderlands with Nyunzu were part of the 2016-2019 Twa-Luba conflict zone with militia attacks and displacement; later incidents are described as sporadic rather than territorial control. Assessed as thin state presence with possible militia raids; unverified for 2026. Twa militia 'raiding' presence is carried over from the 2016-2020 conflict pattern and is not confirmed by a 2025-2026 report.

assessments.zone: Western and central Kongolo territory (Kongolo and Lusangi health zones outside the town): villages along the Lualaba and railway (Sola Boma, Timpa, Masambi, Katele, Mukoko, Mugizya) and the savanna west of the river (Kilembi, Katanga, Katuhuli, Kaseya, Katenta, Kilae, Matenta)
assessments.evidence: No source available to this assessment reports armed-group control in these areas; insecurity is mainly banditry and residual inter-community tension. Assigned to thin state police presence by default.

assessments.zone: Kongolo town (territorial centre; Ville, Maria Mama, Kangoy, Kandolo, Mankoto, Majengo Mapya health areas) plus adjoining Mission and 3 Coins (Keba health area)
assessments.evidence: Kongolo is the seat of the territorial administration with a PNC commissariat, FARDC and ANR presence; no report of armed-group control of the town after the Twa-Luba conflict subsided (~2019-2020). Not verified with 2026 sources.

229.title: DR Congo: Escalating violence in Tanganyika (background on Twa-Luba conflict)

units.CD7409-kongolo: Kongolo territory (northern Tanganyika) straddles the Lualaba river, with Kongolo town as territorial centre, river port and rail stop. The territory was affected by the 2016-2019 Twa-Luba conflict, mainly in its eastern parts toward Nyunzu and Kabambare (Mbulula health zone), but no source available to this assessment reports durable armed-group control of any locality in 2025-2026. Kongolo town (including Mission and 3 Coins) is assessed as police-run with FARDC and ANR present. Rural villages west of the Lualaba and around Kongolo are assigned to default state presence (PNC); the eastern Mbulula health zone is assessed as thinly state-held with possible Twa or Mai-Mai militia raids. Live web research was unavailable (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked), so confidence is low. Reviewer could not run independent web checks either (search budget exhausted, search engines and ReliefWeb blocked); zone structure was checked against health zones/areas and found consistent.
